query: Are Giuseppe Verdi and Ambroise Thomas both Opera composers ?

pipeline_result.response: No, Giuseppe Verdi and Ambroise Thomas are not both Opera composers. Giuseppe Verdi was an Italian opera composer who wrote several operas during his lifetime, including "Mignon" (1866) and "Hamlet" (1868). On the other hand, Ambroise Thomas was a French composer who is best known for his operas "Mignon" (1866) and "Hamlet" (1868), as well as being Director of the Conservatoire de Paris from 1871 until his death.
